title: Rotting Oranges
statement:
You are given an `m x n` grid where each cell can be empty (0), fresh orange (1), or rotten orange (2).
Every minute, any fresh orange that is 4-directionally adjacent to a rotten orange becomes rotten.
Return the minimum minutes until no cell has a fresh orange. If impossible, return `-1`.
hints: Multi-source BFS: put every initially rotten orange in the queue at minute 0.
Count fresh oranges. Each time you rot one, decrease the count.
If fresh oranges remain when the queue empties, return -1.

solution.approach: Enqueue all rotten oranges. BFS level by level; each level is one minute. Track remaining fresh count.

analogy: spoiled fruit spreading through a crate minute by minute
